name: ShroudForge No Fall Damage
description: Clears the local player's typed DynamicFallDamage runtime state.

changelog: Added a declarative overview page for the Modloader UI.
Added a manual fall-state reset action.

components.label: Local client runtime
components.text: When enabled, the mod clears accumulated fall state during gameplay.
The local player's fall start altitude, detected distance, and damage percentage are reset before they can produce fall damage.
